<div class="card-body">
'''Yavin 4: Massassi Ruins''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ヤヴィン4：マサッシ遺跡</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">リーダーがいてここを占領していれば、自分の各宇宙戦闘機はデス・スター星系カード上でそれぞれ戦闘力＋1となる。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配したなら、フォース消耗を＋1できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Yavin-4-Massassi-Ruins-SWCA-67679.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Yavin 4: Massassi Ruins.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Light uses 占領 (occupy) where English uses control, and 宇宙戦闘機 (starfighters) where English uses starships.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Yavin 4: Massassi Ruins]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
